description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Shemar Stewart was diagnosed with a hyperextended knee after an incident in practice Wednesday. No ligament damage was found.
items.impact: After what looked like an ugly injury, it's great news for the Bengals defense. He could sit out for a short period, but it's unlikely this keeps him off the field for long.
items.title: Shemar Stewart diagnosed with hyperextended knee, no ligament damage

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa is back out on the practice field doing individual drills after reports on Wednesday saying he would be back "sooner rather than later."
items.impact: It doesn't appear Tua's injury absence will be anything major, as he's already back at practice. For now he has a leg up on Michael Penix Jr for the QB1 job to start the season with Penix still on the shelf, but things can change quickly in the NFL.
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa doing individual drills Thursday
